text:
mari: quick heads-up — opened PR 4327 to add a short migration checklist for teams moving from hosted -> private installer. noticed the KMS/HSM examples assume an internet fetch for certs, which breaks air-gapped installs.

devx_alex: thanks — can you call out a small preflight step and a tiny conn-check script? that helped a customer.

mari: yes. thinking of adding: 
- --validate-only flag for the installer preflight
- a minimal conn-check script that verifies: DNS for KMS alias, TCP to KMS port, reachable HSM TCP/UDP ports, and file existence for local cert bundle

ops_jordan: +1. also add note about last-mile proxy (squid/nginx) for cert fetches. we had cases where SNAT broke source IP checks on HSM appliance. mention DNAT/SNAT implications.

eng_tanvi: small SDK snippet would help too — show how to configure the KMS endpoint to use a local proxy or socket. e.g.:
```json
{"kms": {"endpoint": "http://127.0.0.1:15001", "ca_bundle": "/etc/redwood/certs/root.pem"}}
```

mari: adding that. also adding a sample iptables rule that preserves source for HSM appliance auth: 
```bash
# preserve source for HSM vendor checks
iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE --random-fully
# or prefer policy-based routing to avoid SNAT on hsm-subnet
```

ops_jordan: can we instead show nftables example too? more customers using nft.

mari: yep will include both. plus a short troubleshooting checklist for common failure modes: 
- bad CA bundle (certificate verify failed)
- port blocked (tcp 5696 for HSM example)
- installer logs: `installer:preflight:network` for debug

devx_alex: tiny wording nit — change "airgap" to "air-gapped" in header and add a link to the offline bundle checksum doc. also add a callout to update the SDK example when cert rotation is documented.

mari: ack. will update PR. tagging reviewers: @eng_tanvi and @ops_jordan.

build-bot: PR 4327 status -> tests:ci passed, lint: minor warnings (docs style).

ops_jordan: link-fix request — the KMS vendor port matrix link in the guide currently goes to an internal spreadsheet. replace with our published port matrix page `/docs/networking/ports` (relative link).

mari: done. pushing changes shortly. final ask — anyone have a one-liner conn-check we can paste? low-friction: `nc -vz kms.example.local 443 && openssl s_client -connect kms.example.local:443 -CAfile /etc/redwood/certs/root.pem -brief`

eng_tanvi: looks good. i'll review after you push. thanks!"
